claim: The cited evidence treats AI-enabled drug discovery and materials science as a real potential benefit, with about $7.6 billion invested in AI drug discovery in 2024-2025 and strong claims about accelerated biological progress.
comparisonContext: This belongs on the site because the long-term debate is not just about infrastructure burdens.
scopeNote: Investment is real; outcomes remain uncertain and should be framed as promising rather than proven.
